fusions.name: Skip Shot
fusions.desc: Skips a bolt of water off the first enemy it meets, dealing 6 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back. For 3 seconds after using it you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Belly Flop
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skittering Leap
fusions.desc: Carries you 6 tiles forward in a burst. Your movement speed rises 30% for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Hair Trigger
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds.
